propositions: inbound_fields.py cannot be moved to adapters/jira/ because it would break the J7 seal preventing jira_datacenter from importing jira's internals
inbound_fields.py cannot be moved to adapters/jira_family/ because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) are forbidden to consume the family layer

decision: keep inbound_fields.py at package root and clarify the exemption's rationale instead of relocating
